glossary.definition: (3) "Fees" means reasonable attorney's fees, in an amount not to exceed seventy-five dollars per hour or a higher hourly fee approved by the court.

glossary.definition: (4) "Internal Revenue Code" means the "Internal Revenue Code of 1954," 68A Stat. 3, 26 U.S.C. 1, as amended.

glossary.definition: (5) "Prevailing eligible party" means an eligible party that prevails in an action or appeal involving the state.
